title: Titanic: Leo's Revenge
author: Volker Lanz
description:
You'll never know how you made it. Anyway, the Titanic sunk and now you're here. Here means, you're swimming in the sea, which is awfully cold and (you knew that before) wet. It is cold, awfully cold, and you're beginning to freeze. Just a few seconds ago, there were legs somewhere down there.

Now, there is nothing.
